mutants.why: appActionStagingBelongsToTheCallNotTheSession requires the service to hold no output directory between calls, so nothing can write to a shared folder outside a call's private staging.
appActionStagingBelongsToTheCallNotTheSession requires each call's action to see its own fresh private staging directory, one per call and never the session's artifact root.
appActionArtifactImportRejectsStagedJunction plants a junction in private app-action staging and requires publication to fail before any redirected tree is copied into managed artifacts.
appActionArtifactImportRejectsStagedJunction also requires cleanup to remove the junction itself without descending into and deleting the outside target.
